title: native models, provisioning and dependency removal

sections.title: P07.2 — native models, provisioning and dependency removal
sections.text:
Status: P07.2 closed GREEN on existing local Validation; further independent review and repeat runs explicitly withdrawn by owner under D108. No independent GREEN verdict is claimed.

Base: `d6ed93fccd9b1ec50428d0f3d18c7c329895c2cd` (captured before product edits). Product anchor: `ef8a2869e0d7ee8f3a1ab5cbfddf60b78d1b4db6`.

Account/Domain are plain central Eloquent models; Account uses HasUuids, explicit typed columns and casts. Native synchronous provisioning, ready-template/integrity checks, export/drop lifecycle and Eloquent host invalidation retain their existing behavior. Renamed implementation classes have no compatibility aliases. Config merge/publish and all consumers use one `corex-tenancy` namespace. The obsolete rule/tests, provider manifests, staging/CI steps and prerelease exceptions were retired.

D107 records the owner's explicit exception: existing SQL in ClaimAccountSignup and PendingPool continues reading/writing `root_accounts.data` for durable signup replay and recoverable cleanup until P08. Models no longer use virtual-column storage or accept arbitrary metadata. No schema migration was made; the durable fields must be relocated before P08 removes the column.

VERIFY-AT-EXEC: Packagist stable v4 releases absent, latest stable v3.10.1; raw response and parsed result in `packagist-stancl.json` / `verify-at-exec.json`.

Lock removes exactly `axiomasoft/stancl-tenancy`, `axiomasoft/stancl-jobpipeline`, `stancl/virtualcolumn` and their exclusive dependency `spatie/invade`; four baseline `composer why --locked` outputs are archived. No retained versions, source/dist references or third-party metadata changed. Only the path tenancy package's removed requirements/description/keyword and root content-hash are reconciled (`lock-delta.json`).

Validation: full tenancy 582 passed, 6 existing Redis skips, 2113 assertions; separate package PG 497 passed, 6 existing Redis skips, 1991 assertions; root package lane 21 suites / 1216 passed; root PG 242 passed / 1156 assertions; architecture 135 passed / 458 assertions. Config-cache 3 passed; Golden 4 passed, only the named 13-class tenancy PHP surface delta; routes/events/wire unchanged. PHP API writes identical, generated API/configuration current. Root lint, all analyse/dependency configurations, manifests positive and injected-prerelease negative, distribution guard tests, contract guards (default + captured base), anti-weakening and package-docs pass. Six obsolete tests are named in `retired-test-inventory.json`; finite sqlite -5 / PG -1 D95 allowance expires when the actual anti-weakening comparison base changes.

BC compares all live packages against the unchanged accepted baseline. Historical private ZIPs are restored only in disposable comparison trees after validating baseline-lock digests; tampered archive negative rejects. Four isolated comparisons run concurrently with deterministic output and propagation of every failure; full `composer bc-check` exits 0. Tenancy's exact finite Roave signature set is bound to accepted D95/D98/D102/D103/D107 hashes; no unknown break or stable bypass is admitted.

Bounded repairs: stale tenancy analyser exceptions were only removed/reduced; obsolete dependency ignore was removed. Root lint required formatting 15 old proof scripts: their baseline identity is archived, and all 15 name-resolved ASTs remain identical. Qualification records retain original RED and exact original GREEN carriers. The first overlapping PG executions were discarded; accepted full/package-PG/root-PG evidence came from sequential runs on isolated `corex_test`, host port 5434.

review: self-check GREEN

Independent review: two completed Grok 4.7/500k FINDINGS verdicts, all five findings fixed. D108 withdraws the close requirement and any further review/retest; original request archived as request.withdrawn-D108.json. Temporary read permission restored.

Delivery topology: a second evidence/bookkeeping commit is required by the explicit post-product-commit Validation and candidate commit SHA deliverables; these cannot truthfully record their own Git anchor in that same product commit. No push, release or P07.3 execution is authorized here. Preserve unrelated CLAUDE.md and local skill/agent files.

Owner closure and new-session direction: D108; owner-close-direction.md. No checks/audits rerun during closure. P07.3 belongs to the new session.
